candidate_workaround: Quarantine exact privacy-scanner definition files as candidates while rejecting matches in all payload files.
failure_signature: An incremental privacy scanner treats its own regex rule definitions as confirmed payload leaks.
recurrence_guard: Separate exact scanner-definition surfaces from payload surfaces and report both counts.
rollback: Retain the failed sealer, make no privacy pass claim, and do not rerun tests or the canonical scan.
scope_boundary: Incremental post-pass privacy classification only; zero confirmed hits is not complete assurance.
title: Quarantine privacy scanner definitions from payload hits
trigger_preconditions: Changed validation scripts contain the privacy patterns they implement.
